row.body: A rubber band holds a service slip to the screwdriver. Four circles are drawn beside one wheel sketch; only the outer groove is filled with dark dust.
row.title: The tire offer marked on a tool handle
row.gloss: A tire drawing and dark groove residue accompany a repair tool.
row.rival_reading: A road crew could inspect tires after a closure and keep a service slip with its tools; the dust does not identify where it came from.

rows.note: Two independent blind reads (DR-20260928-NOHELP-REVIEW-FAST) both missed the declared lean (declared A; votes A 0, B 0, neither 2). Rework so one detail tilts it to its own side while the rival reading stays possible. Keep place, spot, lean, rival, pieces and axioms.

row.body: Four tires are listed on the receipt. Three grease circles appear on the reverse; a small note asks that the smoothest one be saved for a child's bicycle.
row.title: The service receipt for the unreturned wheel

cites.quote: Show this flyer at our outlet

row.gloss: A tire receipt has one unmatched mark and a private request.
row.rival_reading: A farm delivery or ordinary repair could account for a missing tire mark; the receipt does not say that officials concealed an accident.
